_readme: There is no public live API for NHAI/Bhoomi Rashi project status + geometry (see docs/NHAI_BHOOMI_RASHI_FINDINGS.md).
This file is a manually-curated bridge between the two things that ARE public separately:
1. A cited, official ongoing-project STATUS (PIB press release, Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha reply, NHAI bidding-transparency data).
2. REAL geometry for that NH ref/section, taken from the route-analysis response's `nationalHighways[].segments[].coords`
(call /api/route-analysis for a route that follows the NH in question, then copy the relevant coordinate range).
Do NOT invent a status without a citable sourceUrl. Do NOT invent geometry from a place name.
Once a row here is genuinely sourced both ways, submit it through /api/projects/import so it becomes route-eligible.

properties.name: Example: NH44 widening, <section>
properties.ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
properties.statusEvidence: REQUIRED: cite the exact official document (PIB release date + URL, or PQ number + URL) that states this section is under construction.
properties.sourceType: Cited official status + OpenStreetMap NH geometry
properties.sourceUrl: REQUIRED: link to the official status citation above
properties.geometryOrigin: Coordinates copied from route-analysis nationalHighways[].segments for this NH ref — not geocoded from a place name.
